basic_info.description: Built in 2010, 373 6th Avenue is a striking modern three-story single-family home on a real lot behind 371 6th Ave also available for sale that combines architectural style with everyday comfort. Sleek lines, hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and expansive windows create a bright, contemporary atmosphere throughout. A dramatic loft with two-story glass and a central skylight fills the home with natural light, while glass railings and high ceilings add to the sense of space and openness.    The open-concept layout is perfect for both entertaining and daily living, centered around a designer kitchen with granite countertops, a gas range, and professional-grade appliances. Bathrooms feature elegant stone tile and high-end fixtures, and the spacious bedrooms offer flexibility for relaxation, guests, or a home office.    Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and a secure gated entry shared with 371 6th Avenue. Just blocks from the Presidio, Golden Gate Park, shops, cafes, and museums, this home offers a rare combination of modern design and exceptional city living. 1 Car Parking easement from front house. Available individually or together with 371 6th Avenue for a combined offering of approximately 4,000 sq. ft. of living space.
